title: The 10 Best Hot Glue Guns
subtitle: Mini and full-size, dual-temp and cordless hot glue guns for crafts, repairs and woodworking, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A hot glue gun bonds wood, fabric, foam, plastic and paper in under a minute. We ranked 10 best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (dual or adjustable temperature, full-size sticks, cordless use and sticks in the box). Mini guns take 0.27-inch (7 mm) sticks for crafts; full-size guns take 0.43-0.44-inch (11 mm) sticks and push more glue for repairs and woodworking. They run from about $10 for SHJADE's mini kit to $45 for AdTech's 200 W professional gun.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: Gorilla Mini Hot Glue Gun Kit, Dual Temp, Includes 30 Sticks
products.verdict: The most-reviewed glue gun here: a mini gun with a low setting for foam, fabric and floral work, a high setting for wood and plastic, a safety fuse, a built-in stand, and 30 of Gorilla's weather-resistant sticks.
products.skip_if: You glue big pieces; a full-size gun pushes more glue.

products.name: Gorilla Dual Temp Full Size Hot Glue Gun, Precision Nozzle
products.verdict: The full-size version of Gorilla's dual-temp gun with a precision nozzle, for bigger repairs and woodworking.
products.best_for: Home repairs and larger craft projects.
products.skip_if: You need sticks in the box; it's gun only.

products.name: ROMECH 60/100W Dual Temp Hot Glue Gun and Sticks Set, Full Size with Case
products.verdict: The highest-rated glue gun here: a full-size 60/100 W dual-temp gun with a no-drip copper nozzle, 21 high-viscosity sticks and a carrying case.
products.best_for: A full-size gun kit that's ready to go.
products.skip_if: You only do small crafts; a mini gun is easier to steer.

products.name: SHJADE Hot Glue Gun with 30 Glue Sticks, 20W Mini Hot Melt Gun Kit
products.verdict: A $10 mini gun and 30 sticks that sells over 10,000 a month, with a fold-up stand and a 1-3 minute warm-up.
products.best_for: Kids' crafts and a cheap backup gun.
products.skip_if: You need heat control or heavier bonds.

products.name: Krightlink Mini Hot Glue Gun Kit with 30 Glue Sticks, 20W Fast Preheating
products.verdict: A mini gun with a PTC ceramic heater that warms up in about a minute, an anti-drip precision nozzle and 30 sticks.
products.best_for: Precise craft work on a budget.

products.name: Surebonder Cordless Hot Glue Gun, High Temperature, Full Size, 60W

specs.source: Corded, or 3 min off the heating base

products.verdict: A full-size 60 W high-temp gun that lifts off its heating base for about 3 minutes of cordless gluing, hot enough to bond metal, wood, ceramics and leather.
products.skip_if: You want long cordless runs; it's 3 minutes off the base.

products.name: BOSWELL 150W Full Size Hot Glue Gun with 6 Copper Nozzles
products.verdict: A 150 W full-size gun with a temperature dial from 284 to 428°F and six interchangeable copper nozzles for different bead sizes.
products.best_for: Heavy gluing that needs exact heat control.
products.skip_if: You do occasional crafts; it's more gun than you need.

products.name: Tilswall Cordless Hot Glue Gun W106s with Rechargeable 2Ah Battery
products.verdict: A truly cordless mini gun with a built-in 2,000 mAh battery, a 90-second preheat and USB-C charging.
products.skip_if: You glue for hours; the battery limits session length.

products.name: MAXDONE 100W Cordless Hot Glue Gun for DeWalt 20V MAX Battery, Tool Only (NL-237US)
products.verdict: A full-size 100 W gun that runs on DEWALT 20V batteries, so you can glue on a ladder or job site with no cord. Third-party, so DEWALT doesn't warrant it.
products.best_for: DEWALT battery owners gluing away from outlets.

products.name: AdTech Pro200 Industrial Strength Full Size High-Output Hot Melt Glue Gun, 200 W
products.verdict: A professional high-output gun with a 200 W PTC heater at 410°F and a light-pull trigger, for carpentry, remodeling and long production runs.
products.best_for: Carpentry, upholstery and heavy production gluing.
products.skip_if: You do crafts; it runs too hot for foam and fabric.

avoid.name: Assark 30W Mini Hot Glue Gun Kit with 30 Glue Sticks
avoid.flag: Sold as 30 W; model number says 20 W
avoid.verdict: A mini gun sold on a wattage its own model number contradicts. The SHJADE is a dollar cheaper, rated higher and honest about being 20 W.
reasons: The title and bullets sell it as 30 W and claim it heats faster than 20 W guns, but the model number in the spec table is 'HL-E 20W'.
At 4.2 stars it's the lowest-rated glue gun we compared.

buyers_guide.a: Mini guns (0.27-inch sticks) are light and precise for crafts, cards and small repairs. Full-size guns (about 0.44-inch sticks) push much more glue, which you need for wood, larger repairs and long beads.
Low heat protects foam, fabric, ribbon and fingers. High heat bonds stronger to wood, plastic and metal. Dual-temp guns cover both.

buyers_guide.q: How many watts do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 20 W mini guns handle crafts. 60-100 W full-size guns keep up with steady gluing. 150-200 W guns are for production work and heavy repairs.

buyers_guide.q: Are cordless glue guns worth it?
buyers_guide.a: For gluing on ladders, outdoors or around a room, yes. Base-heated guns stay hot only a few minutes off the stand; battery guns run longer.

buyers_guide.q: How do I avoid burns and strings?
buyers_guide.a: Use the stand, keep fingers clear of the nozzle, and try low temperature for delicate work. Drip-free copper nozzles cut down on strings.
